introduction: Singla & Singla Law Firm is widely recognized among the top law firms in Delhi NCR, delivering trusted advocacy, litigation excellence, and strategic legal counsel since 1997. Built on over 28 years of courtroom experience, our firm provides assertive representation across Criminal Defence, Civil Litigation, Matrimonial & Divorce, Corporate Law, Property Disputes, and Cheque Bounce matters.

Ranked by clients and peers among the best law firms in Delhi, we combine deep courtroom mastery with a dedicated, client-first approach to protect rights and resolve complex disputes effectively. From defending intricate criminal trials and bail applications at Karkardooma Court and Delhi District Courts to conducting high-stakes civil suits and writ petitions before the Delhi High Court and Supreme Court of India, our team is committed to upholding justice with unwavering integrity.
Trusted experience. Top legal counsel in Delhi NCR. Dedicated courtroom representation.
history: The practice opened in 1997 with enrolment at the Bar Council of Delhi, and its founding years were spent at Tis Hazari Courts — two under a senior advocate, then establishing an independent chamber handling criminal defence, matrimonial, civil, and MCD panel matters. Driven by exceptional client outcomes, the firm expanded to an established chamber at Karkardooma Court Complex (Chamber F-622) in 2009, a commanding presence across all Delhi district courts, and an active appellate practice before the Delhi High Court and Supreme Court of India.

Nearly three decades on, Singla & Singla Law Firm operates as a leading legal practice in Delhi NCR advising across twelve major disciplines from three strategic chambers in East Delhi — Karkardooma Court, Trilokpuri, and Mayur Vihar Phase 1 — with seasoned advocates, associates, and a dedicated litigation support team managing compliance, urgent filings, and daily court proceedings across Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram.
mission: Our mission is to deliver premier, ethical, and result-oriented legal services as one of the top law firms in Delhi NCR, upholding the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and client confidentiality. We are steadfastly committed to defending our clients' constitutional rights and achieving definitive legal solutions.
vision: To be the leading law firm that regional families, entrepreneurs, and corporations in Delhi NCR turn to first for strategic counsel and resolute court representation.

trustReasons.title: Continuity of counsel
trustReasons.description: The partner who advises you at the consultation appears in your matter. Associates assist; they do not quietly replace.

trustReasons.title: Fees settled in writing first
trustReasons.description: An engagement letter setting out the fee basis precedes any work, with government charges itemised separately from professional fees.

trustReasons.title: Written updates, every hearing
trustReasons.description: You receive a short written note after each listed date explaining what happened and what comes next — not a phone call you have to chase.

trustReasons.title: Candid merits assessment
trustReasons.description: We tell clients when a case is weak, when the timeline makes litigation uneconomic, and when settling is the better commercial answer.

trustReasons.title: Cross-practice coordination
trustReasons.description: A dispute touching tax, banking and corporate exposure is handled by the relevant partners together, not routed around the gaps.

trustReasons.title: Follow-through to enforcement
trustReasons.description: Execution and recovery are part of the mandate. A decree that is never enforced is not a result, and we do not treat it as one.

founder.name: Naveen Singla
message: I opened this practice in 1997 because I had watched too many clients receive advice they could not act on — technically correct, comprehensively hedged, and useless for deciding what to do on Monday morning. I wanted to build a chamber that answered the question the client actually asked.

That is harder than it sounds, because the honest answer is frequently unwelcome. It means telling a client with a genuine grievance that the limitation period has run. It means advising a company that the clause it relied on will not hold. It means recommending settlement to someone who came in wanting to fight. We have lost instructions over such conversations, and I would rather lose them that way.

What we offer is not a promise of outcomes — no advocate can honestly make one. It is a promise about process: you will know where you stand, what it will cost, who is handling it, and what happened at every hearing. Nearly three decades of clients returning, and sending their families and businesses to us, suggests that is worth more than any assurance about results.
